title: Per-pack build-effort instrumentation + outcome ledger
context: M2 success requires demonstrating a measurable reduction in median per-pack build effort (AI-session minutes + human review cycles) relative to the M0/M1 baseline — an effort-reduction metric that guards against scale being asserted rather than measured. Without instrumentation to capture effort data per pack, the M2 metric cannot be verified. This task adds a simple outcome ledger that records build time and review cycles per pack, readable by the steward and referenced in milestone DoDs.
objective: Implement a per-pack build-effort ledger that records AI-session minutes and human-review cycle counts per pack, and emit a summary report so the M2 median-effort metric is measurable against the M0/M1 baseline.
acceptanceCriteria: A ledger schema and update script are implemented so each delivered pack records: pack-id, build session minutes, number of human-review cycles, and delivery date.
A summary report command emits median build-session minutes and median review cycles across all recorded packs, segmented by milestone (M0/M1/M2).
At least one test fixture exercises the ledger update and summary report with synthetic data.
Code is MIT-licensed; pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm lint pass; no credentials embedded; commit is DCO signed-off.
output: packages/ledger/src/ — build-effort ledger and summary report tool; submitted as a PR.
